transmissions.title: Transmission 54: Proof Before Promotion
transmissions.summary: Done means a tested, end-to-end result with a receipt, never a document or profile created — a system that counts only receipts shows zero where nothing is verified, and that zero is the point.

citations.label: Transmission 54: Proof Before Promotion field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 53: A Board, Not a Prompt
transmissions.summary: On 8 November 2026 a single shared file went live so every hand on the machine could see what the others were working on, and within the day more than one kind of hand - including a free local-model agent working beside the subscription coding agent - used it.

citations.label: Transmission 53: A Board, Not a Prompt field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 52: Constraints That Make Autonomy Possible
transmissions.summary: A spending design that keeps two wallets structurally separate and fixes every cap as an absolute figure decided at the time of the ruling — never a percentage of holdings.

citations.label: Transmission 52: Constraints That Make Autonomy Possible field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 51: The Voice at the Door
transmissions.summary: Voice is another door into the same house — not a new set of powers. A deliberately powerless public demo line answers, takes a message, and ends the call; nothing irreversible leaves over voice.

citations.label: Transmission 51: The Voice at the Door field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 50: A Skill Is a Dated Source
transmissions.summary: Every reusable procedure is written once as a single canonical file, linked into every tool that reads it — and a changed version is kept, never silently replaced.

citations.label: Transmission 50: A Skill Is a Dated Source field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 48: One Owner Per Step
transmissions.summary: A post-delivery review found that work split across several agents with no named owner per step repeated a single generalist's old failures, so the job was rewritten as a numbered chain: one owner and one gate for every step.

citations.label: Transmission 48: One Owner Per Step field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 47: A Memory That Outlives the Session

transmissions.title: Transmission 46: One Operator, Many Organs
transmissions.summary: Scope, not powers: a draft motion would extend the operator's reach to the ecosystem's organs, but lifts no condition, promotes no stage, raises no cap, grants no financial capability, and authorizes no act.

citations.label: Transmission 46: One Operator, Many Organs field note

transmissions.title: Transmission 45: Where This Is Going
transmissions.summary: Field note on the plan ahead: agents read a shared board instead of a private prompt, progress is counted only from receipts rather than claims, and authority stays in a human-held wallet until the operator signs.

transmissions.title: Transmission 44: What the Organism Is Afraid Of
transmissions.summary: Field note naming three fears on the record — a self-aware ceiling, the 3 November deletion that cost the vault its history, and RAM once hitting 98.4 percent beside an idle editor — and the laws answering each one: nothing on this machine controls assets, no money moves on its own, one scoped file per credential, and degrade instead of act.

transmissions.title: Transmission 43: An Organism That Hires
transmissions.summary: Field note on an open-source organizational layer installed on the operator's word and left idle: three ways to let it govern hiring, a hire flow in which only the operator's wallet can write the contract, and why nothing is hired yet — proposal first, unpaid trial, paid only by ruling.

transmissions.title: Transmission 42: Pull, Sign, Seal
transmissions.summary: Field note on a design, written 8 November 2026, for running the organism from anywhere: the machine pulls its own requests instead of exposing an inbound port, every request is signed by the operator's passkey, secrets travel sealed end to end, and none of it is built or lawful to run yet.

transmissions.title: Transmission 41: The Audit Counted Eighty-Seven Agents
transmissions.summary: Field note on a read-only audit run by six auditors against the consolidation brief on 8 November: the agent registry holds eighty-seven rows and fourteen are real; seven documents and nothing built; baselines of zero receipts, zero seats and zero revenue; and seventy-four items waiting on the operator.

transmissions.title: Transmission 40: Twenty Seats, One Owner Per Step
transmissions.summary: Field note on the creative agency's growth from four seats on 6 October to twenty seats after nine more were hired on 7 November, and the eighteen-step production pipeline, one owner per step, that now binds every hand under the operator's final word.

transmissions.title: Transmission 39: The Entrance Came Back
transmissions.summary: Field note on a property reel that passed all twenty measured checks and was called final, then the operator found rough transitions, a missing drone opening, soft fonts and captions, a flat grade, and the approved entrance quietly removed; the rebuild reopens exactly as the original opened, locks every approved element, and turns each note into a change list plus a LOCKED list.

transmissions.title: Transmission 38: One Board for Every Hand
transmissions.summary: Field note on the interim job board every Genesis hand reads before acting: claim, finish or hand back, journal; the first job run by a free local model (the free-model hand runs on a local model or a free cloud model); the prompt that did not fit a 32k window; two repaired defects; a memory lesson; and the operator's ruling that nothing stays only on the machine.

transmissions.title: Transmission 37: The Organism Drew Its Chain Boundary
transmissions.summary: Field note dated 2026-11-02 on evolving the Unwind ecosystem onto the Internet Computer without moving its keys: a three-state dividing line written before any code, four canisters (witness, registry, site, console) proven on local replicas only, what a certified read proves and does not, and an automated goal-checker that pressed for a mainnet deploy and was refused under the custody boundary. Mainnet deployment, controllers, cycles, the witness token, and DNS cut-over remain with the operator.

transmissions.title: Transmission 36: Movement Needs a Source
transmissions.summary: Field note on visitor-driven cinematic motion, bounded mobile loading, and the distinction between a verified interface release and Genesis operational readiness. At the 2026-10-22 assessment, a guard service reported healthy while autonomous building remained held, the heartbeat was paused, and end-to-end recovery was incomplete.

transmissions.title: Transmission 34: The Gate That Refused Its Own Operator
transmissions.summary: Field note on custody boundaries between AI build sessions: why relayed authorization cannot lift a custody law, four grants issued and three withdrawn, and a gate that failed closed on evidence it could not read.

transmissions.title: Transmission 35: The Ledger Learned to Be Witnessed
transmissions.summary: Field note on independent attestation: why a witness sharing a credential with the witnessed is a mirror, what thirty-minute granularity actually guarantees, and how silent failure hides inside successful-looking schedulers. Revised 10 November 2026: the witness has been dark since 9 November.
